bullets.title: MU: Earnings Overhang Tomorrow; Short Gamma Risk & AI Deal Catalyst
bullets.body: MU +7% on an AI lab supply deal and is the largest S&P 500 YTD contributor. However, MS QDS flags MU has the second-most short gamma in US equities after SK Hynix, with levered ETF short gamma at record -$18bn/1% move; MU earnings post-close 6/24. Citi models 6%/5% EPS upside for May/Aug quarters, with retail buyers in top 10 most-bought YTD.

bullets.title: CCL: 2Q Beat But FY26 Yield Guide Cut on Mid-East; Multiple Banks Stay Bullish
bullets.body: CCL reported 2Q adj EPS $0.41 vs $0.34 guide and adj EBITDA $1.58B vs $1.48B guide, but FY26 constant-currency yield growth cut to +1.75% from +2.75% on prolonged Mid-East conflict impact on Mediterranean deployments. FY26 adj EPS guidance edged up to $2.22 on cost saves; 2026 bookings 93% full at record prices and 2027 demand tracking strongly. Citi maintains Buy at $37 PT, UBS Buy at $35, Mizuho Outperform at $39—all viewing yield miss as temporary and booking/deferred revenue trends as constructive.

bullets.title: NVDA/AVGO/AMD: CoWoS Capacity & Custom Silicon TAM Raised Dramatically
bullets.body: TSMC CoWoS remains the gating AI supply bottleneck; NVDA expected to consume 1,222k units in 2027 (+57% YoY) driven by Blackwell/Rubin. AVGO's custom silicon revenue potential raised to $250-300B in FY28 if XPV/Apollo financing enables 15GW incremental OpenAI/Anthropic deployments. AMD shows constructive supply posture with Wolfe bull case EPS $25-$30; server CY26 TAM raised to $800B (+82% YoY), CY27 to $1.3T.

bullets.title: MRVL: Hedgeye Long Signal + Raised Pricing; CY26 Enterprise Data Floor 85% YoY Growth
bullets.body: MRVL selectively raised pricing with CY26 enterprise data guidance maintaining 85% YoY growth as a floor, per Wolfe Research. Hedgeye's Signal Strength model also ranks MRVL among top 30 long candidates on price/volume/volatility signals as of 6/23.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Hedgeye Flags Bearish TREND Breakdown; -5% to -6% on Frontier Lab Concerns
bullets.body: Hedgeye flags GOOGL transitioning from bullish to bearish TREND in real-time. GOOGL dropped ~5-6% on concerns about losing frontier lab status to open-source (Zhipu GLM-5.2 seen as Anthropic alternative) and researcher departures. MS TMT notes open-source AI models gaining traction as a structural threat.

bullets.title: MSFT: Technical Profile Deteriorating; Support at 350, Downside Risk to 250
bullets.body: 22V notes MSFT's Technical Score at 0 with the stock below both 50-day and 200-day MAs (200-day still sloping lower). Daily momentum negative since January; relative performance vs S&P 500 at a 6.5-year low. Break below 350 implies downside risk toward 250. Hedgeye also flags MSFT 'morphing into a Bag.'

bullets.title: NFLX: -6% on Weak 3P Data & META Episodic Content Threat
bullets.body: NFLX fell ~6% on weaker global net add signals from third-party data and competitive pressure from META/Instagram launching long-form episodic content on TV. MS TMT also cites growing GOOGL content investment as an incremental headwind. NFLX is near a 50% drawdown per one macro note.

bullets.title: ACN: +3% Pre-Market on $2B Buyback Boost; UBS Sees 20-Year Valuation Low
bullets.body: Accenture boosted its buyback by $2B to $7.5B (~10% of market cap, +62% YoY) after a ~25% five-day selloff on Q3 results and AI disintermediation fears. UBS maintains Buy at $275 PT, citing the stock's 2-year forward P/E at 8.5x—its lowest in 20+ years—and 60%+ of revenue from major AI alliance partners (Anthropic, NVIDIA, OpenAI, Snowflake).

bullets.title: TLN: Jefferies Downgrades to Hold; $453 PT on Full Valuation
bullets.body: Jefferies resumes TLN at Hold with a $453 PT (up from $409), citing shares as fully valued after a robust run. Key concerns include a challenged gas plant contracting outlook, 35%+ EBITDA tied to uncertain PJM capacity auctions, and lower probability assigned to gas data center deals. FCF yield of ~11% with buybacks noted but insufficient for an upgrade.

bullets.title: CEG: 176MW 30-Year Nuclear PPA with Walmart for Dresden Facility
bullets.body: Constellation Energy announced a 176 MW, 30-year nuclear PPA with Walmart starting 2029 for the Dresden Clean Energy Center. This adds to the growing string of hyperscaler/retailer nuclear offtake deals underpinning CEG's contracted revenue base.

bullets.title: TSLA: NHTSA Opens Investigation After Autopilot Fatal Crash in Texas
bullets.body: NHTSA opened a special investigation into Tesla's automated driving system after a vehicle crashed into a Texas home, killing a woman. Tesla's VP claims driver manual override (100% accelerator) caused the crash. This adds to 40+ prior NHTSA probes into Tesla/ADAS incidents.

bullets.title: SNOW/MRVL: Hedgeye Flags Both as Top 30 Long Signal Strength Candidates
bullets.body: Hedgeye's Risk Range Signal Strength model ranks both SNOW and MRVL among its top 30 long candidates as of 6/23, combining TRADE (≤3 weeks) and TREND (≥3 months) signals on price, volume, and volatility.

bullets.title: DIS: Goldman Reiterates Buy/$163 PT; F3Q26 In-Line Expected with 2H Acceleration
bullets.body: Goldman's Michael Ng reiterates Buy on DIS with $163 PT ahead of the F3Q26 print, expecting an in-line result. Experiences segment tracking +13% EBIT with stable parks trends; Goldman models ~13% EPS CAGR through F2028 on operating leverage. Sports faces near-term pressure from higher rights costs.

bullets.title: CRM/ORCL: Liberty Mutual CIO Warns AI Disintermediation Could Pressure Multiples
bullets.body: Liberty Mutual CIO Vlad Barbalat (Invest Like the Best podcast) argues 30-year credit in Salesforce and Oracle is much riskier than near-term paper given AI uncertainty—next trillion-dollar companies may never adopt Salesforce. He sees AI creating structurally higher volatility and steeper credit curves, potentially keeping these names at compressed multiples.

bullets.title: VRT/ENPH: OPCO Bullish on 800VDC Data Center Power Architecture Opportunity
bullets.body: OPCO highlights VRT for its solid-state transformer opportunity and rack-scale battery storage in 800VDC data center architectures, while ENPH's power electronics expertise positions it to serve new entrants in the DC power market migration. GEV and VRT are flagged as the key DC power incumbents.

bullets.title: CLS: Down 6.5% in Canadian Pre-Market on Unspecified News
bullets.body: Celestica (CLS.CN) dropped 6.5% to C$498.60 in Canadian mid-morning trading. No specific catalyst was identified in available sources, but the move coincides with broad semiconductor sector weakness (SOXX -7%).

bullets.title: QCOM: Investor Day Tomorrow (6/24 @ 2:15pm ET); Data Center Focus Expected
bullets.body: QCOM hosts its Investor Day on 6/24 starting at 2:15pm ET with slides/press release expected. Citi notes the event will focus on data center offerings. Multiple desks flagging as a key near-term catalyst for the name.

bullets.title: META/SNAP/GOOGL: Bipartisan KIDS Act Advances; Platform Liability Litigation Risk Rises
bullets.body: The House Energy and Commerce Committee reached bipartisan agreement to advance the Kids Internet and Digital Safety (KIDS) Act, expanding litigation risk for META, SNAP, and GOOGL (YouTube). The next school district bellwether trial is set for February 2027; Section 230 reform and AI-generated content immunity are also under discussion.

bullets.title: AMZN/GOOGL/META: Internet Sector Rebounds; Valuations Attractive vs. TTM Average
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley's internet sector view is Attractive following a +2% sector day. AMZN trades at 26x '26 EPS (-19% vs TTM avg), GOOGL at 25x (-3%), META at 18x (-28%). BKNG +4% and RDDT +8% were notable outperformers as macro fears eased.

bullets.title: HOOD: Prices $2B Convertible; Stock -5.9% Pre-Market
bullets.body: Robinhood priced a $2.0B convertible note offering, sending shares down ~5.9% in pre-market trading. The deal adds to dilution concerns alongside the broader crypto/fintech selloff (BTDR -5.7%, WULF -5.2%, CORZ -4.5%).
